commentary.text: 90+4' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+3' Kike Salas (Sevilla) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Thibaut Courtois makes a brilliant save!
